I: A2 [ I ] When a bird, insect, or aircraft flies, it moves through the air.
I or T: A1 [ I or T ] to travel by aircraft, or to go somewhere or cross something in an aircraft
（乘飛機）飛行，航行；乘飛機去；乘飛機穿過

T: › [ T ] to use a particular company to travel by aircraft
C2 [ T ] to transport people or goods by aircraft
I or T: B2 [ I or T ] to control an aircraft

I: › [ I ] to move or go quickly

I or T: › [ I or T ] to wave or move about in the air while being fixed at one end

I: › [ I ] mainly US If rumours, accusations, etc. fly, they are passed quickly from one person to another and cause excitement.
（謠言、指責等）被興奮地傳播，瘋傳

C: B1 a small insect with two wings
› UK also flies the opening at the front of a pair of trousers
（褲子的）前襠開口，拉鎖蓋，扭扣蓋
› a hook (= curved piece of wire) with coloured threads fastened to it, attached to the end of a fishing line to attract fish
› UK also flysheet an extra sheet of canvas (= strong cloth) stretched over the outside of a tent to keep the rain out

example: The poor bird couldn't fly because it had a broken wing.
這隻可憐的鳥飛不起來了，因為它的翅膀斷了。
As soon as it saw us, the bird flew away/off.
鳥一看到我們就飛走了。
We flew to Paris.
我們乘飛機去巴黎。
We fly from/out from/out of La Guardia, but fly back (in)to JKF.
我們從拉瓜迪亞機場起飛，但返航時在約翰.F.甘迺迪機場降落。
We are flying at a height of 36,000 feet.
我們正在36000呎的高空飛行。
She has to fly thousands of miles every year for her job.
她每年因為工作要飛行上千英里。
Who was the first person to fly (across) the Atlantic?
誰是飛越大西洋的第一人？
I usually fly Lufthansa/Japan Airlines/El Al.
我通常搭乘漢莎航空公司／日本航空公司／以色列航空公司的航班。
The restaurant flies its fish in daily from Scotland.
這間餐廳每天從蘇格蘭空運魚。
We will be flying 100 badly wounded civilians out of the battle zone tonight.
今晚我們將空運100名受重傷的平民離開戰區。
I learned to fly when I was in Australia.
我在澳大利亞時學會了開飛機。
With the explosion, glass flew across the room.
隨著一聲爆炸，房間內玻璃碎片四處橫飛。
Cathy flew by/past me in the corridor.
在走廊裡，凱茜從我身邊飛奔而過。
My holiday seems to have flown (by) (= passed very quickly) this year.
今年我的假期好像飛一般地就過去了。
The door/window suddenly flew open.
門／窗戶猛地打開了。
UK informal Anyway, I must fly (= leave quickly) - I didn't realize how late it was!
無論如何，我必須走了——我都沒意識到有多晚了！
The ship was flying the Spanish flag.
這艘船掛著西班牙國旗。
The flag was flying at half-mast (= brought down to a point half way down the pole) to mark the death of the president.
降了半旗為總統逝世致哀。
There isn't really enough wind to fly a kite today.
今天風確實不大，放不起風箏。
Rumors are flying that the school may close.
謠言瘋傳，說學校可能要關門了。
Hey Chris, your fly's undone!
嗨，克裡斯，你褲子拉鏈開著呢！

NONE: › If ideas, remarks, or accusations are flying about/around, they are passed quickly from one person to another and cause excitement.
（看法、評論、譴責等）滿天飛，四下飛速傳播

example: All kinds of rumours are flying around about the school closing.
有關學校關閉的各種流言滿天飛。

NONE: › to attack another person or animal suddenly
突然攻擊，撲向

example: He flew at his brother like a crazy person.
他瘋了似的撲向他哥哥。

NONE: › the activity of trying to catch fish using a hook made to look like a fly or other insect in order to attract the fish
用假蠅釣鈎釣魚
C2 to completely oppose what seems sensible or normal
與常識相悖

example: This is an argument that seems to fly in the face of common sense.
這個論點似乎與常識相悖。

NONE: › a single thing or person that is spoiling a situation that could have been very positive or enjoyable
美中不足之處；令人掃興的東西（或人）

example: I'm looking forward to Sunday, the only fly in the ointment being the fact that I'll have to sit next to my mother-in-law.
我期待著星期日的到來，唯一令人不快的是，到時我必須坐在岳母旁邊。

NONE: › to suddenly become very angry
勃然大怒

example: I asked to speak to her boss and she just flew into a rage.
我要求跟她的老闆談話，結果她勃然大怒。

NONE: › to react in a very angry way to something that someone says or does
大發雷霆

example: He's extremely irritable - he flies off the handle at the slightest thing.
他極容易發火——芝麻大的小事都能讓他大發雷霆。

NONE: › If you say that you would like to be a fly on the wall on an occasion, you mean that you would like to hear what will be said or see what will happen while not being noticed.
暗中偷聽者；暗中觀察者
› A fly-on-the-wall television programme is one in which the people involved behave normally, as if they are not being filmed.
（電視節目）紀實的

example: I'd love to be a fly on the wall when those two get home!
我想暗中聽聽那兩人回到家說些甚麽！
See also
fly-on-the-wall
a fly-on-the-wall documentary
紀實紀錄片

NONE: › Fly-by-night companies or business people cannot be trusted because they are likely to get into debt and close down the business to avoid paying the debts or satisfying agreements.
（公司或商人）不可靠的，無信用的

example: a fly-by-night operator/organization
不可靠的經營者／機構

NONE: › If an aircraft or the equipment for controlling it is fly-by-wire, it is controlled by computers.
（飛機、飛機設備等）電腦控制的
› an organized holiday that includes your air ticket and the use of a car
（含機票和車費的）空陸聯遊
› illegally sticking a political or other poster (= notice) on a public wall, fence, etc.
非法張貼海報
› illegally leaving things that you do not want next to a road, in fields, in rivers, etc.
亂倒垃圾（非法在道路旁邊、田野或河流等地傾倒垃圾）
› Flyaway hair is soft, light, and difficult to keep in place.
（頭髮等）飄拂的，淩亂的
› a flight, especially in a spacecraft, past a particular point in space
（尤指太空船的）近天體飛行
› US UK flypast an occasion when a group of aircraft flies in a special pattern as a part of a ceremony
檢閱飛行，機群編隊飛行

example: The pictures were taken during the spacecraft's 25-minute flyby of the asteroid.
這些照片是在太空船靠近小行星的25分鐘飛行期內拍攝的。

NONE: › a small bird that catches insects in the air
鶲（鶲科小鳥，在飛行時捕食昆蟲）

C: › a small piece of paper with information on it about a product or event
› a person who travels by air

example: Frequent flyers receive travel privileges.
經常搭乘飛機的乘客可以享受旅行優惠。

NONE: › travel by air
搭乘飛機

example: Annette's scared of flying.
安妮特害怕乘飛機。

NONE: › an aircraft shaped like a boat at the bottom, and able to land on water
水上飛機（底部像船一樣的航空器，能在水上降落）
› an arch built against a wall, especially of a church, to support its weight
（尤指教堂的）拱扶垛，栱柱
› a doctor, usually in Australia, who travels by air to see ill people who live a long way from a city
（澳大利亞乘飛機到偏遠地區出診的）飛行醫生
› a tropical fish that can jump above the surface of the water using its very large fins
飛魚（熱帶魚類，鰭大，能跳出水面）
› a large bat that eats fruit
狐蝠，果蝠
› a worker who travels to support workers who are on strike at another place of work
（別處工廠罷工時前去聲援的）流動宣傳員
› old-fashioned for
UFO
› a small group of police officers that is trained to act quickly, especially when there is a serious crime
飛虎隊，快速特警隊
› to begin something very well, quickly making good progress
迅速的起步；開始時的優勢
› an instance of one competitor in a race starting more quickly than the others
（賽跑的）快速起跑

example: She's got off to a flying start in her new job.
她的新工作起步非常好。

NONE: › a very short visit
短暫訪問，閃電式訪問
› an empty page at the beginning or end of a book next to the cover
（書籍前後的）空白頁，襯頁

C: › [ C ] UK US overpass a bridge that carries a road or railway over another road
跨線橋，天橋；上跨立體交叉
